Mine candidate factor variables across waves for the dictionary

Source: R/mine_factors.R
mine_factors.Rd

Internal helper for dict_init(). Scans each wave in clean_list for character columns that look categorical (via detect_factor_potential()), and builds the raw Factor_Levels rows for them: one row per unique value per flagged variable, with a provisional target_name resolved from wide_map.

Usage

mine_factors(clean_list, wide_map, max_unique = NULL)

Arguments

clean_list

Named list of sanitized data frames (post janitor::clean_names()), one per wave.

wide_map

The wide variable map built by dict_init(), used to resolve each factor row's target_name.

max_unique

Passed through to detect_factor_potential(). Defaults to NULL.

Value

A data.frame of candidate factor rows (possibly zero rows), with columns wave, original_variable, target_name, original_level, standard_code, standard_label.
